iconography.summary: Where an icon belongs and what it must look like. Decide the slot first, then whether the slot needs an icon at all, then draw it from the one set. Pattern: icon-placement. Five worked variations per slot are rendered in examples/icon-slots/.

set.style: One family. Outline only or filled only, never both on one page. Filled is allowed only as the selected state of an outline icon.
set.stroke: One stroke width for the whole set, 1.5 to 2 units on the 24 grid, round caps and joins.
set.color: currentColor. The parent sets the color with a text token; no per-icon hue.
set.alignment: Center the icon on the first line of its label, not on the whole text block. 16px beside 14 to 16px text, 20px beside 18 to 20px text.
set.accessibility: Decorative icons get aria-hidden. An icon-only control gets an accessible name on the control.

slots.name: Control icon
slots.covers: Buttons, toolbar actions, navigation items, close, menu, search, disclosure chevrons, external link, download.
slots.test: Does the icon trigger, open, close or move something?
slots.keep_when: The icon is the control itself (icon-only button), or it is a convention people scan for (search, close, menu, back, more, external link).
slots.instead: A text label. A primary action with a clear verb needs no leading icon.
slots.accessibility: Icon-only control: aria-label on the button, aria-hidden on the svg, a 44px hit area.

variations.name: Icon-only toolbar
variations.use_when: Frequent actions on a dense surface, where each glyph is a convention (search, download, share, close).
variations.shows: Accessible name on each button, 44px hit area, md size.

variations.name: Secondary button with icon
variations.use_when: Secondary actions next to each other, where the icon helps scanning but the word carries the meaning.
variations.shows: sm icon before the verb. The primary action with a clear verb gets no icon.

variations.name: Search and clear inside a field
variations.use_when: A search or filter input.
variations.shows: One leading glyph says what the field is, one trailing control clears it.

variations.name: Disclosure chevron
variations.use_when: Rows that expand: accordions, settings groups, tree rows.
variations.shows: One chevron, rotated for the open state, at the end of the row.

variations.name: Mobile app bar
variations.use_when: Top bar of a phone screen.
variations.shows: Back and more only; the title sits between them as text.

slots.name: Explanatory icon
slots.covers: Feature cards, benefit lists, category entries, file types, step lists.
slots.test: Would a reader lose information if the icon were removed?
slots.keep_when: The icon carries meaning the words do not: a file type, an integration, a category that repeats elsewhere as a filter or navigation key. It is chosen for that item, not to fill a slot.
slots.instead: Nothing. Or a number with its unit, a short label, a real screenshot or product crop, or a list with plain bullets.
slots.accessibility: aria-hidden, because the text beside it says the same thing.

variations.name: A number instead of an icon
variations.use_when: Feature or benefit cards whose point is a measurable fact.
variations.shows: Label and figure with its unit; the icon slot is gone.

variations.name: Numbered steps
variations.use_when: A process with an order.
variations.shows: An ordered list with the step name in bold; no step icons.

variations.name: Crop of the real product
variations.use_when: A section that needs a picture.
variations.shows: A small cut of the actual screen or data instead of a symbolic glyph.

variations.name: File type list
variations.use_when: Lists of files, attachments or exports.
variations.shows: Keep the icon: it tells the type. sm size, aligned to the first line.

variations.name: Category that repeats as a filter
variations.use_when: Category names that also appear in navigation or filters.
variations.shows: lg glyph next to the name, the same glyph wherever the category appears.

slots.name: Identity mark
slots.covers: The product logo, partner and integration logos, payment and platform marks, people in avatars.
slots.test: Does the mark stand for a specific brand, product or person?
slots.keep_when: Always, but only as the original asset: the supplied vector, the owner's official file, or the person's photo.
slots.instead: A marked placeholder and a request for the file. Initials for a person without a photo. Never a redrawn lookalike or a generic glyph standing in for a brand.
slots.accessibility: Alt text with the brand or person name, or empty alt when the name is printed beside it.

variations.name: Wordmark in the header
variations.use_when: The product logo in the site header.
variations.shows: The supplied SVG with outlined text, linked home.

variations.name: Monochrome logo strip
variations.use_when: Customer or partner logos as proof.
variations.shows: One gray, original proportions, real marks only.

variations.name: Integration list
variations.use_when: Connected services and what each one does.
variations.shows: The partner's official mark at 24px beside its name and one line.

variations.name: Photo, then initials
variations.use_when: People: authors, members, assignees.
variations.shows: The photo when there is one, initials when there is not, a count for the rest.

variations.name: Marked placeholder for a missing file
variations.use_when: A logo or mark is needed but the file is not supplied.
variations.shows: A dashed slot that names the file to request; never a lookalike.

slots.name: Data marker
slots.covers: Trend arrows, legend swatches, check and cross marks in comparison tables, chart markers. Status (live, failed, paused) is written as a word, not a colored dot.
slots.test: Does the mark encode a value or a state that is also written next to it?
slots.keep_when: It sits beside the number or word it encodes and uses shape as well as color, so it reads in grayscale.
slots.instead: The word or the number alone. A status label instead of a colored dot. A table cell with "Included" or a dash reads faster than a column of green discs.
slots.accessibility: The text carries the meaning; the marker is aria-hidden. Color is never the only signal.

variations.name: Trend arrow beside the delta
variations.use_when: A KPI with a change since the last period.
variations.shows: sm arrow next to the delta, and the direction said in words too.

variations.name: Words in a comparison table
variations.use_when: Plan or feature comparison.
variations.shows: Included, none, or the actual limit; no check discs.

variations.name: Status word with a supporting shape
variations.use_when: Connection, job or sync status.
variations.shows: The status is written; a neutral outline glyph supports it. No colored dot.

variations.name: Line style legend
variations.use_when: A chart with two or more series.
variations.shows: Solid and dashed swatches with the series name and value beside them.

variations.name: Shape coded severity
variations.use_when: Issues or alerts ranked by severity.
variations.shows: One outline shape per level and the level name in text, readable in grayscale.

slots.name: No icon
slots.covers: Headlines and section headings, hero copy, section kickers, paragraphs, FAQ questions, footer columns, every item of a long list.
slots.test: Is the icon only there because the slot looked empty?
slots.keep_when: Never. These slots are carried by type, space and real content.
slots.instead: Size, weight and space for hierarchy. A real image or number when the section needs a visual.
slots.accessibility: Nothing to label, because nothing is drawn.

variations.name: Hero in type only
variations.use_when: The first screen of a landing page.
variations.shows: Headline, one sentence, one action.

variations.name: Split section header
variations.use_when: A section introduction.
variations.shows: Title on the left, explanation on the right.

variations.name: Plain FAQ
variations.use_when: Questions and answers.
variations.shows: Questions as text with hairlines; no question mark glyphs.

variations.name: Prose with a pull quote
variations.use_when: Long form text.
variations.shows: Indent and one thin rule for the quote.

variations.name: Text footer
variations.use_when: Site footer columns.
variations.shows: Column titles and text links; no glyph per column.
